name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.TLWEGGH15.wide_gate
title: Clause-gated wide leaf error is gated by the full path product
statement: For matrices X, Y, M, F over a commutative ring, (X kron Y) * ((M kron I) * F) = ((X * M) kron Y) * F. In the masked gamma-tensor GGH15 candidate with structured wide leaf error (M_{h,b} kron I) F, the surviving wide error of a path is ((j_C M_z) kron s'_0 S'_{<h}) F, which vanishes when the path product M_z is zero.
